# REMAINING_WORK — Mobile Cleanliness Wave

The Awtsmoos keeps unfinished edges visible until every vessel can hold its light;
Awtsmoos.com will not call a route complete while a menu escapes the screen or a raw control breaks the night.

## Active

- Inspect and runtime-probe Adventure at 390×844 and 320×568, including open menus/HUD/touch controls.
- Inspect and runtime-probe Ohrbound at 390×844 and 320×568, including overlays/pause/settings/orientation behavior.
- Inspect and runtime-probe DB Console, especially forms, results/tables, query controls, and mobile stacking.
- Inspect and runtime-probe Broadcaster, especially sidebars, preview, device controls, action rows, and safe-area behavior.
- Run final Video Editor drawer/timeline/transport/popover/focus mobile acceptance.
- Run a global static risk scan for layout conflicts and incomplete styling across public apps/games.
- Run readiness-aware browser probes on risk-ranked routes, never measuring before real styles/modules are ready.
- Rewrite only proven defects with complete-file modular replacements.
- Verify every touched route at desktop, 390×844, 320×568, and short-height behavior relevant to the page.
- Record planned-versus-actual delta and rerun global hygiene checks.

## Completed before this wave

- Main 80-door discovery constellation and catalog completeness gate.
- Captions responsive/declarative UI rewrite.
- Captions storage/randomization contracts.
- Captions modular worker render graph and spatial-index performance improvement.
- Captions architecture gate and real 1080×1920 JPEG render acceptance.

## NEXT_ACTION

Collect source ownership, git status, entry files, loaded CSS/JS graph, and obvious layout-risk declarations for Adventure/Ohrbound/DB Console/Broadcaster. Then rank actual risk before any production rewrite.
